exam_name: Assam Judicial Service Examinations, Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET)
text_in: On 8 January 2025, ABSU and prominent Bodo organizations including Bodo Sahitya Sabha, Bodo Samaj, Harimu Afad (cultural organisation), All Assam Tribal Sangha, and All Bodoland Territorial Region (BTR) Venture Senior Secondary School Employees' Association staged a protest in all the district headquarters of Assam including Sonari town (Charaideo, Assam) with 6 demands including the inclusion of the Bodo language in the Assam Judicial Service Examinations and Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET), the establishment of 35 new Bodo medium high schools, the provincialization of Venture Schools under Clause 6.3 of the BTR Accord, the filling of vacant spots and dropout positions in Bodo medium schools along with the recruitment of teachers and upgradation of 101 Bodo medium high schools to higher secondary schools.

On 29 November 2024, 6 student organizations including SFI and DYFI staged a protest at Dighalipukhuri locality in Guwahati city (Kamrup Metropolitan, Assam) demanding the withdrawal of the draft rules for Assam's college teacher recruitment process claiming that it would take away autonomy from colleges.
